methodology.title: How we rank
methodology.intro: What goes into each ranking, and why we measure it this way. No black box.
methodology.erDesc: For photos and carousels. We add up likes and comments and divide by the account's followers. It's the same math the whole industry uses — so any account can be compared to any other.
methodology.verDesc: For Reels. Here we divide by views, not followers — a video can reach far more people than the account has followers. Views show who actually watched.
methodology.terDesc: Same as Reels, plus shares. On TikTok shares are public (on Instagram they aren't), and a share is one of the strongest signs the content landed.
methodology.equalDesc: A like, a comment and a share all count the same. No secret formula, no hidden weighting — a simple rate anyone can check and compare.
methodology.dontDesc: Only public numbers count. Saves are out (Instagram doesn't show them), and so are Instagram shares — on TikTok they're visible, so there they count.
methodology.windowDesc: A day is a full day, measured in each account's own time zone — so every team gets the same 24 hours, wherever they are.

about.title: About
about.lead: We rank football by real engagement — not by follower count. Every day.
about.p1: Every day we look at the biggest football accounts on Instagram and TikTok and see which posts the fans actually got behind — clubs in season, national teams during the big tournaments. No opinions, no takes: the ranking is what the audience did, not what we think.
about.p2: We count likes, comments, views and shares at equal weight, the same way the industry measures it — no secret formula. The math behind every number is all there on the methodology page.
about.p3: Every number comes from what's public on the post itself. We never guess or use private data — only what anyone can see and check.
about.p4: The index goes out here on the site and every day on @datafootball__, on Instagram and TikTok.

footer.contentRights: Posts, images and videos belong to their respective clubs, national teams and creators. DataFootball is an independent project that indexes only publicly available engagement data and links back to the original posts. Not affiliated with Instagram, TikTok or any league or federation.
